WITH bronze_nulls AS (
  SELECT 
    'Bronze' AS layer,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sex IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS sex_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN occp_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS occp_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN reporter_country IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS reporter_country_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN e_sub IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS e_sub_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN occr_country IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS occr_country_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN age_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS age_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN age_grp IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS age_grp_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wt_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS wt_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN i_f_code IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS i_f_code_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rept_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS rept_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mfr_sndr IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS mfr_sndr_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mfr_num IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS mfr_num_nulls
  FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/demo`
), silver_nulls AS (
  SELECT 
    'Silver' AS layer,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN sex IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS sex_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN occp_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS occp_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN reporter_country IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS reporter_country_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN e_sub IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS e_sub_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN occr_country IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS occr_country_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN age_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS age_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN age_grp IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS age_grp_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN wt_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS wt_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN i_f_code IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS i_f_code_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rept_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS rept_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mfr_sndr IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS mfr_sndr_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mfr_num IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS mfr_num_nulls
  FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/demo`
) SELECT * FROM bronze_nulls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM silver_nulls

WITH bronze_nulls AS (
  SELECT 
    'Bronze' AS layer,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN role_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS role_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN route IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS route_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dechal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dechal_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rechal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS rechal_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_freq IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_freq_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN prod_ai IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS prod_ai_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN val_vbm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS val_vbm_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_vbm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_vbm_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_unit IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_unit_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_form IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_form_nulls
  FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/drug`
), silver_nulls AS (
  SELECT 
    'Silver' AS layer,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN role_cod IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS role_cod_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN route IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS route_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dechal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dechal_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN rechal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS rechal_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_freq IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_freq_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN prod_ai IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS prod_ai_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN val_vbm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS val_vbm_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_vbm IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_vbm_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_unit IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_unit_nulls,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dose_form IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS dose_form_nulls
  FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/drug`
) SELECT * FROM bronze_nulls UNION ALL SELECT * FROM silver_nulls

SELECT 'DEMO' AS table_name, 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/demo` UNION ALL SELECT 'DEMO' AS table_name, 'Silver' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/demo` UNION ALL SELECT 'DRUG' AS table_name, 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/drug` UNION ALL SELECT 'DRUG' AS table_name, 'Silver' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/drug` UNION ALL SELECT 'REAC' AS table_name, 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/reac` UNION ALL SELECT 'REAC' AS table_name, 'Silver' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/reac` UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTC' AS table_name, 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/outc` UNION ALL SELECT 'OUTC' AS table_name, 'Silver' AS layer, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/outc`

SELECT 'Bronze' AS layer, COUNT(DISTINCT drugname) AS distinct_drugnames FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/bronze/drug` UNION ALL SELECT 'Silver' AS layer, COUNT(DISTINCT drugname) AS distinct_drugnames FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/drug`

SELECT 
  'Before: age_cod = YR only' AS comparison_type,
  CASE 
    WHEN age IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN age < 18 THEN '< 18'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 35 THEN '18-35'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 51 AND 65 THEN '51-65'
    WHEN age > 65 THEN '> 65'
  END AS age_range,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/demo` WHERE age_cod = 'YR' AND age IS NOT NULL AND age >= 0 AND age <= 120 GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN age IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN age < 18 THEN '< 18'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 18 AND 35 THEN '18-35'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 51 AND 65 THEN '51-65'
    WHEN age > 65 THEN '> 65'
  END
UNION ALL SELECT 
  'After: All units normalized' AS comparison_type,
  CASE 
    WHEN age_years IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN age_years < 18 THEN '< 18'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 18 AND 35 THEN '18-35'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 51 AND 65 THEN '51-65'
    WHEN age_years > 65 THEN '> 65'
  END AS age_range,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM delta.`/Volumes/main/default/faers_data/delta/silver/demo` WHERE age_years IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CASE 
    WHEN age_years IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
    WHEN age_years < 18 THEN '< 18'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 18 AND 35 THEN '18-35'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 36 AND 50 THEN '36-50'
    WHEN age_years BETWEEN 51 AND 65 THEN '51-65'
    WHEN age_years > 65 THEN '> 65'
  END

## 🎯 FAERS Camada Silver - Análise de Impacto na Qualidade dos Dados
### Comparação Antes e Depois

Este painel demonstra o **impacto mensurável** das transformações de limpeza de dados aplicadas na Camada Silver do pipeline FAERS (2022Q4-2023Q4).
### 1️⃣ Impacto do Tratamento de Nulos - Tabela DEMO
**Transformação**: Todos os valores NULL categóricos substituídos por 'UNK'

lines:
### 4️⃣ Impacto da Normalização de Idades
**Transformação**: Todas as unidades de idade (YR, DEC, MON, WK, DY, HR) normalizadas para o campo padronizado `age_years` com validação de intervalo 0-120

**Antes**: Apenas registos com `age_cod = 'YR'` podiam ser utilizados para análise de idade (~subconjunto dos dados)  
**Depois**: TODAS as idades normalizadas para anos → **Dados de idade utilizáveis expandidos de subconjunto para conjunto completo!**

--- ### ✅ Resumo Geral do Impacto na Qualidade dos Dados **Principais Conquistas:** * **Tratamento de Nulos**: Todos os valores NULL categóricos substituídos por 'UNK' em 22+ colunas nas tabelas DEMO e DRUG → **100% de completude de dados categóricos** * **Desduplicação**: Desduplicação baseada em funções de janela removeu: - **DRUG**: 783 registos duplicados - **REAC**: 109.081 registos duplicados
→ **Melhoria na precisão dos dados e redução do armazenamento** * **Normalização de Strings**: Padronização de Drugname (trim + upper + remoção de caracteres não alfanuméricos) → **Redução de variações distintas de nomes de medicamentos** para agregação precisa em análises * **Normalização de Idades**: Todas as unidades de idade (YR, DEC, MON, WK, DY, HR) convertidas para o campo padronizado `age_years` com validação 0-120 → **Representação consistente de idades** em todos os registos **Resultado**: Os dados da Camada Silver estão **limpos, consistentes, validados e prontos para análise na Camada Gold**! 🎯
